set -euo pipefail
V=/tmp/voice777-pocket-venv-20260912T132000Z
WAV=/tmp/voice777-pocket-last-20260912T132000Z.wav
AVAIL=$(df -Pk /tmp | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
if [ -z "$AVAIL" ] || [ "$AVAIL" -lt 8000000 ]; then echo "VOICE777_FAIL insufficient_tmp_kib=$AVAIL"; exit 42; fi
echo "VOICE777_PREFLIGHT tmp_available_kib=$AVAIL python=$(python3 --version 2>&1)"
python3 -m venv "$V"
. "$V/bin/activate"
python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -q --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 'torch>=2.5.0'
python -m pip install -q 'pocket-tts==3.1.0'
OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 taskset -c 0,1 nice -n 10 python - <<'PY'
import json, os, statistics, time
import torch
import scipy.io.wavfile
from pocket_tts import TTSModel

torch.set_num_threads(2)
texts = [
    'Guten Abend. Ich bin OMEGA.',
    'Ich höre dir zu und antworte direkt.',
    'Ja. Das können wir jetzt sauber testen.',
    'Moment. Da stimmt etwas nicht.',
    'Das ist interessant. Erzähl weiter.',
    'Nein, so würde ich es nicht machen.',
    'Okay. Ich bin noch da.',
    'Sehr gut. Dann gehen wir den nächsten Schritt.'
]

def meminfo():
    out={}
    with open('/proc/meminfo') as f:
        for line in f:
            p=line.replace(':','').split()
            if len(p) >= 2 and p[1].isdigit(): out[p[0]]=int(p[1])
    return out

mi0=meminfo()
start_load=os.getloadavg()
t0=time.perf_counter()
model=TTSModel.load_model(language='german')
model.to('cpu')
load_s=time.perf_counter()-t0
t1=time.perf_counter()
voice_state=model.get_state_for_audio_prompt('juergen')
voice_s=time.perf_counter()-t1
runs=[]
last_audio=None
for text in texts:
    s=time.perf_counter(); first=None; chunks=[]
    for chunk in model.generate_audio_stream(model_state=voice_state, text_to_generate=text, copy_state=True):
        if first is None: first=time.perf_counter()-s
        chunks.append(chunk.detach().cpu())
    elapsed=time.perf_counter()-s
    audio=torch.cat(chunks, dim=-1) if chunks else torch.empty(0)
    duration=float(audio.numel())/float(model.sample_rate) if audio.numel() else 0.0
    rtf=(elapsed/duration) if duration>0 else None
    runs.append({'text':text,'first_audio_ms':round(first*1000,1) if first is not None else None,'elapsed_s':round(elapsed,3),'audio_s':round(duration,3),'rtf':round(rtf,4) if rtf is not None else None})
    last_audio=audio
if last_audio is not None and last_audio.numel():
    scipy.io.wavfile.write('/tmp/voice777-pocket-last-20260912T132000Z.wav', model.sample_rate, last_audio.numpy())
firsts=sorted(r['first_audio_ms'] for r in runs if r['first_audio_ms'] is not None)
rtfs=[r['rtf'] for r in runs if r['rtf'] is not None]
def pct(xs,p):
    if not xs: return None
    i=max(0,min(len(xs)-1,int(round((len(xs)-1)*p))))
    return xs[i]
mi1=meminfo()
result={
  'schema':'OMEGA_VOICE777_POCKET_BENCH/v1',
  'host':os.uname().nodename,
  'cpu_affinity':[0,1],
  'torch_threads':torch.get_num_threads(),
  'model':'pocket-tts-3.1.0',
  'language':'german',
  'voice':'juergen',
  'sample_rate':model.sample_rate,
  'model_load_s':round(load_s,3),
  'voice_state_load_s':round(voice_s,3),
  'first_audio_p50_ms':round(statistics.median(firsts),1) if firsts else None,
  'first_audio_p95_ms':pct(firsts,0.95),
  'first_audio_worst_ms':max(firsts) if firsts else None,
  'rtf_p50':round(statistics.median(rtfs),4) if rtfs else None,
  'rtf_worst':max(rtfs) if rtfs else None,
  'loadavg_before':start_load,
  'loadavg_after':os.getloadavg(),
  'mem_available_kib_before':mi0.get('MemAvailable'),
  'mem_available_kib_after':mi1.get('MemAvailable'),
  'wav':'/tmp/voice777-pocket-last-20260912T132000Z.wav',
  'runs':runs
}
print('VOICE777_BENCH_JSON='+json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
PY
